name: table
need: Compare records in columns: sort, select in bulk, act per row

--ds-table-row-hover.description: the row hover layer on the cells; a fixed colour where `color-mix(currentColor)` misbehaves

--ds-table-row-selected.description: a selected table row (`.ds-table__row--selected`, a checked checkbox in a cell)

--ds-table-head-height.description: table header cells: the base (size md, comfortable density) that size and density steps apply to ([options.md](options.md)); the block padding follows

--ds-table-row-height.description: table body cells: the base (size md, comfortable density) that size and density steps apply to ([options.md](options.md)); the block padding follows

--ds-table-dense-row-height.description: the fixed height of the cells of `.ds-table--dense` (deprecated, with the class)

--ds-table-padding.description: the side padding of table cells and of an open detail: the base that density steps apply to (2px per step)

--ds-table-sticky-bg.description: the opaque base of sticky rows and pinned columns, and the background of `.ds-table-wrap--fill`

--ds-table-max-height.description: the most height of a wrapper around `.ds-table--sticky-head` or `.ds-table--sticky-foot`: set it, so the rows scroll under the sticky ones

--ds-table-pin-last-width.description: the width of a `.ds-table--pin-last` column, set by the page on the wrapper: its end `scroll-padding`, so focus moved by the keyboard never lands under the column

--ds-table-cell-max-width.description: where a cell of `.ds-table-wrap--fill` is cut with an ellipsis

--ds-table-fill-min-height.description: the least height of `.ds-table-wrap--fill` (a short window scrolls the view instead)

--ds-selection-bar-height.description: the least height of `.ds-selection-bar`: the base that size and density steps apply to
